name: Gremlins

releases.author: xRyul
releases.description:
## Missing list marker cleanup

Gremlins 0.5.0 adds an opt-in **Missing list markers** rule for malformed pasted lists. It conservatively identifies a prose line that appears to have lost both its list marker and its intended indentation, then lets you repair it with the existing gutter action or current-line fix command.

### Example

With Obsidian's **Indent visual width** set to `4`, this malformed list now highlights the indentation before `Confirm...`:

```md
- [ ] Work
    - [ ] Prepare report library
        - [ ] Add archive items:
    Confirm the structure for the central report archive
            - Determine how reports should be stored
            - Define metadata requirements
```

After clicking the Gremlin gutter icon:

```md
- [ ] Work
    - [ ] Prepare report library
        - [ ] Add archive items:
            - Confirm the structure for the central report archive
            - Determine how reports should be stored
            - Define metadata requirements
```

## Safeguards

- The rule is disabled by default because converting prose into a list item is heuristic.
- Detection requires the malformed line to be exactly one indent level shallower than the preceding list item and the following unordered item to be exactly one level deeper.
- Ordinary continuation text indented beneath its parent remains unchanged.
- Tabs and spaces are measured using Obsidian's configured indent width.
- Fixes copy the following unordered marker style (`-`, `+`, or `*`).
- Gremlins never rewrites the note automatically.

## Configuration

Enable **Settings → Gremlins → Missing list markers**. To repair highlighted lines from the gutter, also enable **Gutter icons** and **Click gutter icons to fix**.
releases.name: Gremlins 0.5.0

releases.author: xRyul
releases.description:
## List-shaped indented code detection

The opt-in **List indentation** rule now highlights top-level ordered, unordered, and task-list markers that Obsidian parses as indented code. This closes a detection gap for list-shaped blocks indented by exactly one Markdown code level.

### Example

Before - these markers are now highlighted as orphaned list indentation:

```md
## Items

    1. First item
    2. Second item

## More items

    - First item
    - Second item
```

After fixing each contiguous block:

```md
## Items

1. First item
2. Second item

## More items

- First item
- Second item
```

## Safeguards

- Valid nested lists remain unchanged.
- Fenced and inline code remain excluded.
- The existing block-aware fix preserves children and continuation lines.
- Incomplete Markdown syntax trees still fail closed to avoid temporary warnings.

Markdown cannot distinguish an accidentally indented list from intentional indented code containing the same list-shaped text. Intentional indented-code lines beginning with list markers are therefore highlighted when this opt-in rule is enabled.

## Configuration

The behavior remains part of **Settings → Gremlins → List indentation**, which is disabled by default. Automatic gutter fixes still require **Click gutter icons to fix**.
releases.name: Gremlins 0.4.2

releases.author: xRyul
releases.description:
## Block-aware orphaned-list fixes

Orphaned list indentation warnings can now be fixed safely from the gutter. Selecting any Gremlin in a contiguous orphaned block removes the block's shared minimum indentation in one atomic edit.

### Example

Before:

```md
Common issues:
    - Parent
        - Child
    - Sibling
```

After selecting any Gremlin in the block:

```md
Common issues:
- Parent
    - Child
- Sibling
```

## What is preserved

- Nested children keep their relative indentation.
- Continuation lines move with their list block.
- Tab- and space-indented blocks are both supported.
- Blank or unindented lines remain block boundaries.
- Other fixable characters on the selected line are fixed in the same edit.

The block-aware behavior works from both the gutter and the **Fix current line or orphaned list block** command.

## Configuration

Orphan detection remains part of **Settings → Gremlins → List indentation**. Gutter fixes require **Click gutter icons to fix** to be enabled.
releases.name: Gremlins 0.4.1

releases.author: xRyul
releases.description:
## Orphaned list indentation

Gremlins can now warn when a Markdown list marker is indented even though it has no parent list item. The rule supports both spaces and tabs and works in Source mode and Live Preview.

### Example

Before - each indented marker is now highlighted as a Gremlin:

```md
Parents
    - Child
    - Child
    - Child
    - Child
```

After - move the list to the top level when that is the intended structure:

```md
Parent
- Child
- Child
- Child
- Child
```

The same warning appears when the indentation before each marker is a tab rather than spaces.

## Parser-aware safeguards

- Preserves valid nested unordered, ordered, and task lists, including deep nesting.
- Ignores parser-recognized fenced and indented code.
- Waits for complete Markdown syntax information instead of producing temporary false positives.
- Keeps orphaned-list warnings non-fixable because changing one line automatically could alter the hierarchy of following items.

## Configuration

This behavior is part of the existing **List indentation** rule, which remains disabled by default. Enable it under **Settings → Gremlins → List indentation**.

releases.author: xRyul
releases.description:
## Gutter controls no longer overlap

Gremlin icons now use the editor's existing outer space instead of sharing the folding-control hit area. The note content keeps exactly the same horizontal position with Gremlins enabled or disabled.

### With line numbers

```text
[Gremlin] [line number] [fold arrow] [content]
```

![Gremlin positioned before the line number and folding arrow](https://github.com/xRyul/gremlins/releases/download/0.3.2/gremlins-gutter-with-line-numbers.png)

### Without line numbers

```text
[Gremlin] [fold arrow] [content]
```

![Gremlin positioned in the existing editor margin before the folding arrow](https://github.com/xRyul/gremlins/releases/download/0.3.2/gremlins-gutter-without-line-numbers.png)

## Improvements

- Keeps the Gremlin gutter at zero effective width, avoiding content movement or reduced line width.
- Places Gremlins before line numbers when line numbers are enabled.
- Uses Obsidian's existing folding space when Gremlins is the only gutter.
- Keeps heading and nested-list folding controls visible and independently clickable.
- Works in Source mode and Live Preview, including folded content.
releases.name: Gremlins 0.3.2

releases.author: xRyul
releases.description:
## Mixed indentation fixes

- Fixes tab-led mixed indentation losing meaningful nesting when fixed e.g.: 
- Applies the list-indentation normalization rule to mixed indentation using Obsidian's current **Indent visual width**.
- Rounds to the nearest indentation level, with ties rounded to the deeper level.
- Normalizes tab-led indentation entirely to tabs and space-led indentation entirely to spaces.
- Preserves nested-list hierarchy for mixed indentation introduced while indenting blocks in Obsidian.

What it means is that:
 - 1 tab + 3 spaces now when "Squashing Gremlin" will resolve to = 1 tab + 1 tab. 
 - 1 tab + 1 space will now resolve to = 1 tab.
releases.name: Gremlins 0.3.1

releases.author: xRyul
releases.description:
## List indentation

- Adds a dedicated, opt-in **List indentation** rule for malformed Markdown list indentation.
- Uses Obsidian's current **Indent visual width** when detecting and fixing list indentation.
- Rounds indentation to the nearest configured level, with ties rounded to the deeper level.
- Preserves the existing indentation style: spaces remain spaces, while tab-led mixed indentation keeps its tabs.
- Uses Obsidian's Markdown parser to avoid flagging list-like content inside code blocks and other non-list contexts.
- Supports unordered, ordered, and task list items in Source mode and Live Preview.

## Improvements

- Mixed-indentation width calculations now follow Obsidian's current indent visual width instead of assuming four columns.
- Adds regression coverage for list depths, configurable widths, parser context, fixes, settings, and tooltips.
releases.name: Gremlins 0.3.0

releases.author: xRyul
releases.description:
## Mixed indentation

- TAB + SPACE when pressing on Gremlin will become only a TAB. This is for cases where we have mixed indentations e.g. 1 bullet is more indented than other. Gremlin flags it, user clicks on Gremlin, indentation is back to be as the rest of indentations.

releases.author: xRyul
releases.description:
## Em dash support

- Adds `U+2014` em dash (`—`) detection to the optional typographic punctuation rules.
- Replaces em dashes with ASCII hyphens (`-`) when click-to-fix is enabled.

## Custom Gremlin gutter icon

- Replace the generic bug with an original Gremlin icon designed for 12–16 px gutters.
- Inherit error, warning, and info colours from the active Obsidian theme.
- Keep the icon visible and clickable with line numbers enabled or disabled.
- Refresh the README preview to showcase invisible Unicode, mixed indentation, optional typography, tooltips, and the new icon.

- Keep the editor body aligned when Gremlins gutter icons are enabled.
- Keep Gremlin icons visible and clickable with line numbers enabled or disabled.

releases.author: xRyul
releases.description:
## Click-to-fix gremlins

- Add an opt-in setting to fix every gremlin on a line by clicking its gutter icon.
- Normalize spacing and punctuation, remove flagged invisible controls, and convert mixed indentation to Markdown-safe spaces.
- Show a brief explosion animation when a gremlin is fixed.
- Add **Gremlins: Fix current line** for keyboard and touch workflows.
- Apply each line fix in one undoable editor transaction.

releases.author: xRyul
releases.description:
## Initial release

- Highlight zero-width characters, bidirectional controls, non-breaking spaces, soft hyphens, and related Unicode gremlins.
- Detect leading indentation that mixes tabs and spaces.
- Show severity-coloured editor decorations and gutter icons.
- Display character names, Unicode code points, and severity on hover.
- Optionally highlight typographic punctuation.
- Inspect the gremlin at the cursor from the command palette.
